subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Battery Cost and the $100 Threshold
description: One-minute skill: Battery Cost and the $100 Threshold.

hook.text: In 2010, EV battery packs cost over $1,100 per kilowatt-hour. By 2023, they fell below $140.

buildup.text: The magic number is $100 per kWh—economists say that's when EVs become cheaper than gas cars to build.

discovery.text: LFP packs from China are already approaching that threshold, with some estimates just above it.

twist.text: Reaching $100 doesn't just make EVs affordable—it kills the price argument that keeps gas cars alive.

climax.text: Once batteries cross that line, the economic tipping point for mass EV adoption becomes unstoppable.

punchline.text: One price drop will change who buys electric forever.

quiz.question: What is the key battery cost threshold for EV price parity with gas cars?
